phone.notes: Halloween skins (earned by beating the floors of Impmon's dungeon, chosen for each Digimon with the Skin button and seen by other players), easier dungeon bosses, fairer PvP rivals, the farm list shows who is training, and fixes for the boost list, the dungeon Back/Give up buttons and the farm animation. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: The Battle menu and the wild Digimon give and take vitals again like the bracelet battles (the ones met while walking give half). If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.

phoneStore.notes: New list of attacks in battle (name, level, element, damage and MP), MP rework, the boost list no longer shows boss items, and Digimon of player cards no longer have absurd speed. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.
